recorded.outcome:q-two-lock-report: a supported by L164-165: an unlock publishes to later locks of that monitor, not of any monitor; a reader locking something the writer never locks has no edge; L186-187 same lock required.

recorded.outcome:q-timed-await-subtotals: d supported by L155-159 and L278: the edge goes to actions after a successful return from await(); a return of false is not one; Summary L262-263.

recorded.outcome:q-session-user-after-put: b supported by L86-87 (write after put has no edge; consumer may see it whole, in part, or not at all) and L128-129 (mutable value put in a ConcurrentHashMap then changed in place); L280-281.
recorded.prompt:q-sleeping-test: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-sleeping-test: a supported by L226-231 (JLS 17.3: sleep has no synchronization semantics) and L244-247 (even when the warmer finished in time, no edge connects its writes to the test's reads).

recorded.prompt:q-verbose-heartbeat:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-verbose-heartbeat:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-verbose-heartbeat:a: Refuted by L234-235: the writer never takes that lock, so the JLS gives no edge.
recorded.prompt:q-verbose-heartbeat:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-verbose-heartbeat:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-verbose-heartbeat:c: Refuted by L233: println ended the loop because it takes a lock, not because output slows it; 'reaches main memory' is not the page's model (hang is JIT hoisting, L193-194). Partly true: 'only hides the bug' matches the page.
recorded.prompt:q-verbose-heartbeat:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-verbose-heartbeat:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-verbose-heartbeat:d: Refuted by L195 (log line didn't fix it) and L233-236 (lock is the mechanism, no edge).
recorded.prompt:q-two-lock-report:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-lock-report:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-two-lock-report:b: Refuted by L164 (edge only to later locks of that monitor). Partly true: its 'No' conclusion is right; only the reason is wrong. The page never mentions declaring class; the 'says' adds that point, but it follows from L164.
recorded.prompt:q-two-lock-report:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-lock-report:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-two-lock-report:c: Refuted by L164: 'not of any monitor'.
recorded.prompt:q-two-lock-report:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-two-lock-report:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-two-lock-report:d: Refuted by L164-165 and Reference L298: a lock the writer doesn't take gives no edge.
recorded.prompt:q-timed-await-subtotals:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-timed-await-subtotals:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-timed-await-subtotals:a: Refuted by L146, L155: the timed await returned false on timeout and the code proceeded; it did not wait further.
recorded.prompt:q-timed-await-subtotals:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-timed-await-subtotals:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-timed-await-subtotals:b: Refuted by L157-159: a false return gets no edge.
recorded.prompt:q-timed-await-subtotals:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-timed-await-subtotals:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-timed-await-subtotals:c: Refuted by L25-26 (every write before the release, to any object) and L256-259 (data passed needs no volatile). Arrays are not named explicitly, but 'any object' covers them.
recorded.prompt:q-session-user-after-put:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-session-user-after-put:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-session-user-after-put:a: Refuted by L86-87 and L128-129: writes after the put have no edge.
recorded.prompt:q-session-user-after-put:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-session-user-after-put:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-session-user-after-put:c: Refuted by L86-87; L246-247 (finishing in time gives no edge).
recorded.prompt:q-session-user-after-put:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-session-user-after-put:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-session-user-after-put:d: Refuted by L21-23 and L280: the edge is to the access 'in another thread'; L160-162 non-null retrieval. Partly true: 'No particular value' is the right conclusion.
recorded.prompt:q-sleeping-test:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sleeping-test:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-sleeping-test:b: Refuted by L246-247: finishing in time gives no edge.
recorded.prompt:q-sleeping-test:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sleeping-test:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-sleeping-test:c: Refuted by L227-229: compiler need not reload values after sleep; rereading on HotSpot is 'not a promise' (L230-231).
recorded.prompt:q-sleeping-test:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-sleeping-test:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-sleeping-test:d: Refuted by L226-228: sleep has no synchronization semantics, so it orders nothing across threads. Partly true: 'Nothing about the records' is the right conclusion.
